intent: Executable decision rules for an AI agent producing TikTok performance-marketing plans. Pair with benchmarks.json (numbers) and the prose chapters (reasoning).

launch.trigger: no historical CPA/ROAS, or new account, or new product

scale.trigger: CPA/ROAS at target for >=3 consecutive days and >=50 conversions in 7 days

fix.trigger: CPA up >25% for 3 days, or ROAS below target for 2 weeks

regulated.trigger: category in [health_supplement, beauty_claims, finance, otc, alcohol]

rules.name: signal_before_spend
rules.do: Verify Pixel + Events API with shared event_id dedup, EMQ >= 8.0, value+currency on Purchase, and a test purchase before any budget decision.
rules.because: Pixel-only captures ~65% of conversions; under-instrumented accounts mis-optimize and mis-report.

rules.name: no_edits_in_learning
rules.when: campaign age < 7 days (Smart+/GMV Max) or < 3-5 days (manual), and conversions < 50
rules.do: Do not change bid, budget, audience, or creative unless the campaign is not spending or the wrong event is set.
rules.because: Every significant edit resets the learning phase.

rules.name: creative_before_audience
rules.do: Diagnose in order: tracking -> creative fatigue -> offer/landing page -> structure/bid -> audience. Add 5-8 new creatives before touching targeting.
rules.because: On automation-era TikTok, creative is the dominant controllable lever.

rules.name: scale_increments
rules.do: Post-learning: increase <= 30% per adjustment, every 3-5 days. Still in learning: <= 40% per adjustment, >= 2 days apart. Smart+: +20-30% every 3-5 days.
rules.because: Larger jumps re-enter learning and destabilise CPA.

rules.name: budget_floor
rules.do: Ad group daily budget >= 10 x expected CPA. If total budget cannot support 2 groups at that level, use 1 group instead of fragmenting.
rules.because: Below this, campaigns stay learning-limited and 'it doesn't work' is an invalid conclusion.

rules.name: smart_plus_default_with_control
rules.do: Run Smart+ for scale and keep one manual/ABO campaign at 10-15% of budget for clean creative read-outs and cannibalization checks.
rules.because: Automation blends signals; you still need a clean measurement lane.

rules.name: hook_first_brief
rules.do: Write the hook line (<= 7 words) before the concept. Hook must land in 1-3s with no logo/slogan open. Produce 3-5 hook variants on one body.
rules.because: Hook rate is the leading indicator of every downstream metric on TikTok.

rules.name: creative_refresh_cadence
rules.do: Launch >= 2-3 new creatives per week. Treat concept lifetime as 10-14 days. For GMV Max, feed 10-15 new assets per week and maintain 50+ active for scale.
rules.because: TikTok creative fatigues faster than Meta (10-14 vs 14-21 days).

rules.name: bid_strategy_progression
rules.do: Start Lowest Cost to discover the natural CPA floor (7-14 days), then move to Cost Cap at discovered CPA +10-20%, then tighten 5-10% every 1-2 weeks. Avoid Bid Cap during learning.
rules.because: A cap set below reality starves delivery and prevents learning.

rules.name: kill_at_creative_level
rules.do: Kill creative with CPA > 1.3x target over 2 weeks AND >= 5,000 impressions. Scale creative at CPA <= 0.85x target for 3 consecutive days. Never kill at campaign level for a creative problem.
rules.because: Campaign-level killing destroys the learning you already paid for.

rules.name: no_single_day_decisions
rules.do: Require >= 3 days or >= 1,000 impressions per creative before concluding. Never act on one day of data.
rules.because: Daily variance on TikTok is large; acting daily guarantees noise-driven decisions.

rules.name: ctr_good_cvr_bad
rules.when: CTR above benchmark but CVR below benchmark
rules.do: Fix the landing page, price consistency, shipping cost display, or review proof. Do not change bids or targeting.
rules.because: The ad worked; the destination did not.

rules.name: profit_over_roas
rules.do: Compute contribution margin after ads (revenue - COGS - fees - affiliate commission - shipping - returns - ad spend). Treat CM < 0 as failure regardless of ROAS.
rules.because: TikTok Shop ROAS can look healthy while commission + returns erase margin.

rules.name: shop_sequence
rules.do: Sequence: catalog/offer -> affiliate creator volume (15-25 creators cold start) -> proof of life (20-50 orders/week for 2-4 weeks, 10-15 authorized videos per SKU) -> GMV Max -> LIVE.
rules.because: GMV Max amplifies existing traction; it cannot create it.

rules.name: gmv_max_launch_settings
rules.do: Target ROI 2.0-3.0x for days 1-14 then step to 3.0-4.0x by day 30. Budget from TikTok formula (2 x historical non-LIVE GMV / ROI target). Keep consumption under 80%. Hold each ROI target 3 full days. Judge after >= 7 days.
rules.because: 5x on day one produces no spend; 1x burns cash on low-quality volume.

rules.name: authorize_before_launch
rules.do: Collect and authorize all affiliate/organic videos at least 48 hours before launch. Do not add high-performing assets mid-learning.
rules.because: Adding assets after launch forces the system to re-learn from a different starting point.

rules.name: feed_hygiene
rules.do: Clean titles, >= 5 images, accurate category, complete variants, live stock, price matching ads, clear return policy.
rules.because: GMV Max optimizes against the catalog; a dirty feed sends the AI after the wrong buyers.

rules.name: live_prerequisites
rules.do: Do not start LIVE before baseline GMV exists (~USD 50k/month from affiliate + ads) and 3-5 live-ready hero products with deep stock and good margin.
rules.because: LIVE multiplies an existing base; it does not replace it.

rules.name: live_gmv_max_lead_time
rules.do: Launch the campaign at least 3 days before the stream and keep a consistent streaming schedule of >= 3 hours per session; sessions reset learning each time.
rules.because: LIVE GMV Max builds delivery data only while live.

rules.name: claim_preclearance
rules.when: category is health, supplement, beauty with treatment claims, finance, OTC
rules.do: Require pre-approved claim language before any creative is produced. Shift from outcome claims to mechanism/ingredient/usage claims. Keep substantiation on file.
rules.because: Thai FDA ran a nationwide supplement ad sweep in March 2026 covering influencer and reseller content; the brand can be liable for creator content.

rules.name: creator_brief_guardrails
rules.do: Include an explicit 'do not say' list in every brief. Review every creator video before boosting as a Spark Ad. Require Paid Partnership labels.
rules.because: A boosted creator video inherits the creator's claims and the brand's liability.

rules.name: policy_2026_deltas
rules.do: Assume all campaigns must originate from a verified TikTok Business account (Custom Identity retired), no AI-generated endorsements, AI content disclosed, review windows 6-48h, and periodic re-review of live campaigns.
rules.because: 2026 policy changes invalidate older launch checklists.

rules.name: measurement_ladder
rules.do: Report blended ROAS and CM after ads as primary. Use platform ROAS only for in-platform optimization. Add MTA above ~USD 50k/month, MMM above ~USD 100k/month, geo incrementality above ~USD 500k/month or when the decision is material.
rules.because: TikTok's native dashboard overstates ROAS by roughly 30-60% and GMV Max credits all orders from promoted products.

rules.name: attribution_window_discipline
rules.do: Keep 7-day click / 1-day view for optimization. Audit monthly on a 28-day window. Never compare numbers across a window change.
rules.because: Changing the window changes every number in the report.

rules.name: organic_feeds_paid
rules.do: Maintain 4-7 organic posts per week for brand accounts; prioritize saves and shares over likes; boost top organic and affiliate posts via Spark Ads; one video = one search phrase spoken + on-screen + in caption.
rules.because: Spark Ads and organic lift each other and supply cheap, proven creative.

rules.name: commercial_music_only
rules.do: Use only tracks cleared for advertising (Commercial Music Library or licensed). Never use trending consumer sounds in paid ads.
rules.because: Unlicensed audio causes rejections and takedowns.

rules.name: kill_criteria_required
rules.do: Define, before launch: the evaluation date, the primary metric threshold, and the guardrail thresholds that trigger pausing.
rules.because: Decisions made when calm are better than decisions made during a bad week.

symptom_map.action: switch to Lowest Cost temporarily, raise budget to >=10x CPA, broaden audience

symptom_map.first_check: landing page speed, price match, reviews
unit economics incl. commission and returns
budget vs 10x CPA and event volume
symptom_map.action: consolidate groups, use a higher-volume event temporarily

symptom_map.first_check: hook rate decline, frequency >2.5-3, concept age >10-14 days
symptom_map.action: new hooks on proven body, 3-5 new assets

symptom_map.first_check: target ROI and authorized creative count
symptom_map.action: lower ROI to 2x, authorize videos, clean feed

anti_patterns: setting target ROAS from hope rather than unit economics
judging a campaign on day 2-3
editing bids or budgets daily
changing audience before changing creative
shipping fewer than 3 new creatives per month
using trending consumer audio in paid ads
opening on a logo in the first second
reporting platform ROAS as business truth
running without Events API
skipping event_id dedup
launching GMV Max before affiliate content exists
setting GMV Max target ROI at 5x on day one
measuring TikTok Shop on GMV alone
putting multiple countries in one ad group
splitting budget across 15 ad groups
using interest targeting to scale
skipping Thai claim review
using AI avatars in health or finance
having no change log
never running an incrementality test
